WITH t AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
m AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS minc
    FROM t
    GROUP BY Segment
),
a AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.Consumption) / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avgc
    FROM t
    JOIN m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.Consumption = m.minc
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS d1,
    (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS d2,
    (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avgc FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS d3

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2013 AS PctIncrease
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease FROM pct WHERE PctIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PctIncrease) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease FROM pct WHERE PctIncrease = (SELECT MIN(PctIncrease) FROM pct);

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestCustomers AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, ct.CustomerID, ct.TotalConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotals AS ct
    INNER JOIN MinPerSegment AS m ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
),
SegmentAvg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM LowestCustomers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

    FROM yearmonth AS ym

)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease

WITH target AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      AND l.status = 'A'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ( (SELECT t.balance
          FROM trans AS t
          WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
            AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
          LIMIT 1)
        - (SELECT t.balance
           FROM trans AS t
           WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
             AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
           LIMIT 1)
      ) * 100.0
      / (SELECT t.balance
         FROM trans AS t
         WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
           AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
         LIMIT 1) AS increase_rate;

SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT < 60 GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.Birthday ORDER BY MAX(T2.GPT) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT < 60 AND Patient.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT T1.Date FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."First Date" = (SELECT MAX("First Date") FROM Patient) AND T1.LDH >= 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.ALP >= 300 AND Patient.Admission = '+';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.ALP < 300
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.TP > 6.0 AND T2.TP < 8.5
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5 AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5 AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT Examination."aCL IgG", Examination."aCL IgM", Examination."aCL IgA"
FROM Examination
INNER JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= 6.5
ORDER BY Laboratory.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(Examination.ANA) FROM Examination JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory AS L INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Examination.ANA FROM Examination WHERE Examination.ID = (SELECT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` < 2.0 ORDER BY Laboratory.`T-BIL` DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND E.KCT = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-CHO" < 250 AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'P';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.TG < 200 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.Thrombosis = 0 AND T2.CPK < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID) FROM (SELECT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.CPK < 250 INTERSECT SELECT Examination.ID FROM Examination WHERE Examination.KCT = '+' OR Examination.RVVT = '+' OR Examination.LAC = '+') AS t
SELECT MIN(Patient.Birthday) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GLU > 180
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID) FROM Examination JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GLU < 180 AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Admission = '+' AND CAST(Laboratory.WBC AS REAL) BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Laboratory.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.PLT > 100 AND Laboratory.PLT < 400 AND Patient.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.PLT FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.PLT > 100 AND T1.PLT < 400 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
SELECT AVG(CAST(Laboratory.PT AS REAL)) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(Laboratory.PT AS REAL) < 14

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Examination.ID = Patient.ID
      AND Examination.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
      AND Laboratory.PT < 14
);

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE MIN(T2.element, T3.element) || '-' || MAX(T2.element, T3.element) = (
    SELECT MIN(A.element, B.element) || '-' || MAX(A.element, B.element)
    FROM connected AS C1
    JOIN atom AS A ON C1.atom_id = A.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS B ON C1.atom_id2 = B.atom_id
    GROUP BY MIN(A.element, B.element), MAX(A.element, B.element)
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(c.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS annual_average_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013 AS c
    JOIN lowest_per_segment AS l
      ON l.Segment = c.Segment AND c.total_consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Difference_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Difference_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Difference_KAM_SME;

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM cons
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase AS PercentageIncrease
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct_increase AS PercentageIncrease
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct);

JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT PA.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT PA.potential
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
  AND PA.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND PA.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT date FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Constant') AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Constant')) ORDER BY date LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T2.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND T1.date = '2012-02-22'
SELECT buildUpPlayDribblingClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND Team_Attributes.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';
SELECT chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes WHERE team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle') AND date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00'

SELECT T_At.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T_At
JOIN Team AS T ON T_At.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND T_At.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT (l.overall_rating - j.overall_rating) * 100.0 / l.overall_rating
FROM
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan')
     AND date LIKE '2013-07-12%') l,
  (SELECT overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes
   WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')
     AND date LIKE '2013-07-12%') j;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(birthday))) > 34

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Player AS P
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11)
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
WHERE p.player_name = 'Daan Smith' OR p.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira';

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id WHERE CAST((julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(T2.birthday))) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) <= 30
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.finishing = 1 GROUP BY T1.player_name ORDER BY MAX(strftime('%s', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%s', T1.birthday)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT Country.name
FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) AS mp
JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
JOIN Country ON Country.id = mp.country_id
GROUP BY Country.name
ORDER BY AVG(Player.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

WITH im AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
pids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM im
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN pids ON p.player_api_id = pids.pid;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')
SELECT CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';
SELECT DISTINCT buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);
SELECT L.name FROM League AS L JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(pa.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(P.id) FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' 
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - dt.A11 AS gap
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MIN(dt2.A11)
                FROM client c2
                JOIN district dt2 ON c2.district_id = dt2.district_id
                WHERE c2.gender = 'F')

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'Owner' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T2.status = 'C'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND l.status = 'A'
  AND a.date LIKE '93%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND l2.status = 'A'
        AND a2.date LIKE '93%'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date)
              FROM trans
              WHERE date LIKE '95%' OR date LIKE '1995%');

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;
SELECT T1.client_id FROM client AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id WHERE T3.issued = '1994-03-03'
SELECT account.date FROM account JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT T1.district_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.date = '1994-08-25' AND T2.status = 'A'

SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN loan l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND c.gender = 'F';
SELECT disp_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE amount = 5100 AND date = '1998-09-02')

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND (account.date LIKE '1996%' OR account.date LIKE '96%');

SELECT district.A2 FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';
SELECT account_id FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY account.date LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH target AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status IN ('A', 'C')
  ORDER BY loan_id
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
  SELECT balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    AND date = '1993-03-22'
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
  SELECT balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
    AND date = '1998-12-27'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0 / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';
SELECT d.A2, d.A3 FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = '4990'

SELECT loan.account_id, district.A2 AS district, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT T3.A2, SUM(T1.amount) FROM trans AS T1 JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.type = 'VYDAJ' AND T1.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY T3.A2 ORDER BY SUM(T1.amount) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.client_id NOT IN (
      SELECT dp2.client_id
      FROM card cd
      JOIN disp dp2 ON cd.disp_id = dp2.disp_id
  )

SELECT d.A3
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount)
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';
SELECT A3, A2 FROM district WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '950101' AND '971231'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE gender = 'M' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY CAST(A15 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date LIKE '97%';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold'

SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%m', date)) AS avg_credit_card_amount_per_month
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase

WITH ariel AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
paulin AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (ariel.overall_rating - paulin.overall_rating) * 100.0 / paulin.overall_rating AS percentage_higher
FROM ariel, paulin;

SELECT (LD.overall_rating - JB.overall_rating) * 100.0 / LD.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM
    (SELECT PA.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes PA
     JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
     WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') LD,
    (SELECT PA.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes PA
     JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
     WHERE P.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
       AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%') JB;

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p1 ON m.home_player_1 = p1.player_api_id
JOIN Player p2 ON m.home_player_2 = p2.player_api_id
JOIN Player p3 ON m.home_player_3 = p3.player_api_id
JOIN Player p4 ON m.home_player_4 = p4.player_api_id
JOIN Player p5 ON m.home_player_5 = p5.player_api_id
JOIN Player p6 ON m.home_player_6 = p6.player_api_id
JOIN Player p7 ON m.home_player_7 = p7.player_api_id
JOIN Player p8 ON m.home_player_8 = p8.player_api_id
JOIN Player p9 ON m.home_player_9 = p9.player_api_id
JOIN Player p10 ON m.home_player_10 = p10.player_api_id
JOIN Player p11 ON m.home_player_11 = p11.player_api_id
WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p1.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p2.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p3.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p4.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p5.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p6.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p7.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p8.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p9.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p10.birthday)) <= 30
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p11.birthday)) <= 30;

INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Patient.`First Date` < '2000-01-01';

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY Patient.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA >= 8 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID) FROM Patient AS t1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t2.DNA < 8 AND t1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND P.Admission = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60;
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T2 WHERE T2.ID IN (SELECT T1.ID FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE T1.GOT >= 60)

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);

SELECT MAX(T1.Date)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.LDH >= 500
  AND T2."First Date" = (
      SELECT MAX("First Date")
      FROM Patient
      WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH >= 500)
  )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP >= 300 AND T1.Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.ALP < 300;
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.TP > 6.0 AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5
  AND ALB < 5.5
  AND ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB)
             FROM Laboratory
             WHERE ALB > 3.5
               AND ALB < 5.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2."aCL IgA" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT e.ANA
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` < 2.0
  AND l.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-BIL` < 2.0);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T3.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0 AND T3.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250
  AND (T2.KCT = '+' OR T2.RVVT = '+' OR T2.LAC = '+');
SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.GLU < 180 AND E.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '+' AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND p.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient AS P 
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.PLT > 100 AND L.PLT < 400 AND P.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;
SELECT T1.PLT FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.PLT > 100 AND T1.PLT < 400 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
SELECT AVG(T1.PT) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.PT < 14

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis IN (1, 2) AND CAST(T3.PT AS REAL) < 14

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, SUM(y.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN min_per_segment m 
        ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (

           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
           ) * 100.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT p.Segment AS Segment, SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM per_customer AS p
    JOIN min_consumption AS m ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,

WITH seg AS (

         (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)

  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')

JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Parma' AND C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT Player.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.overall_rating = 77
  AND Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY Player.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT PA.overall_rating FROM Player P JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND PA.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT PA.potential
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
  AND PA.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND Player_Attributes.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT PA.date
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND PA.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(PA2.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes PA2
      JOIN Player P2 ON PA2.player_api_id = P2.player_api_id
      WHERE P2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY PA.date
LIMIT 1;
SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND TA.date = '2012-02-22'

SELECT T.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T
JOIN Team AS TM ON T.team_api_id = TM.team_api_id
WHERE TM.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND T.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'
SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS TA JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND TA.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT T2.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team AS T1 JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle' AND T2.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00'
SELECT T1.chanceCreationCrossingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T2.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND T1.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%'

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT (PA1.overall_rating - PA2.overall_rating) * 100.0 / PA1.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM Player AS P1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA1 ON P1.player_api_id = PA1.player_api_id
JOIN Player AS P2
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA2 ON P2.player_api_id = PA2.player_api_id
WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND P2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND date(PA1.date) = '2013-07-12'
  AND date(PA2.date) = '2013-07-12'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime') - datetime(birthday) > 34

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.home_player_1 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_2 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_3 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_4 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_5 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_6 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_7 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_8 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_9 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_10 = T2.player_api_id OR T1.home_player_11 = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'

SELECT SUM(T1.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2
  ON T1.away_player_1 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_2 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_3 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_4 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_5 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_6 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_7 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_8 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_9 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_10 = T2.player_api_id
  OR T1.away_player_11 = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Daan Smith' OR T2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira';

SELECT SUM(home_team_goal)
FROM Match
WHERE match_api_id IN (
    SELECT M.match_api_id
    FROM Match AS M
    JOIN Player AS P
      ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11)
    WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P.birthday)) < 31
)
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY T1.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON PA.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(P.height) AS average_height
FROM Player P
JOIN (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) M ON P.player_api_id = M.player_api_id
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT Player.player_api_id FROM Player JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY Player_Attributes.potential ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa'

SELECT T1.team_long_name AS home_team, T2.team_long_name AS away_team, M.home_team_goal, M.away_team_goal FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id JOIN Team T1 ON M.home_team_api_id = T1.team_api_id JOIN Team T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
SELECT PA.sprint_speed, PA.agility, PA.acceleration FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'
SELECT T_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes ON T.team_api_id = T_Attributes.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' AND Country.name = 'Italy' AND League.name = 'Serie A'
SELECT MAX(Match.home_team_goal) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY League.name ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);
SELECT P.player_name FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY MAX(PA.overall_rating) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(PA.id) AS percentage FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND l.loan_id IS NULL
SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995, AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996, CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_year FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND CAST(district.A11 AS INTEGER) > 8000

SELECT a.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
ORDER BY client.birth_date DESC, district.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) FROM disp JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND disp.type = 'Owner'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.status = 'C'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1997'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY T2.amount ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993' ORDER BY T2.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov';
SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM trans WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995')

SELECT disp.client_id
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25'
SELECT MAX(t.amount) FROM trans t JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND t.date >= a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN account ON client.client_id = account.account_id AND account.account_id IN (
    SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik'
)
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND client.gender = 'F'

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM trans
JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100 AND trans.date = '1998-09-02';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2 FROM client JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.A4 = (SELECT MAX(A4) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia')

SELECT (t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN trans t1 ON t1.account_id = a.account_id AND t1.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t2 ON t2.account_id = a.account_id AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS pct_paid_no_issue FROM loan
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT client.client_id, account.account_id, account.frequency
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;
SELECT account.account_id, account.date FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice'
SELECT d.A2, d.A3 FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = '4990'

SELECT loan.account_id, district.A2, district.A3
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.amount > 300000

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT district.district_id, ((district.A13 - district.A12) / district.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.status = 'D';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(c.client_id) DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM disp
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
LEFT JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE LOWER(district.A3) = 'south bohemia'
  AND card.card_id IS NULL;
SELECT d.A3 FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(d.A16 AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(A16 AS INTEGER)) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0;

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM loan AS l
INNER JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) FROM account JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE account.district_id = 1 AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A15 = (SELECT A15 FROM district ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT district.A2
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE trans.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', trans.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1)

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestIncrease,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestIncrease;

JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg = (
      SELECT MAX(s2.weight_kg)
      FROM superhero s2
      JOIN publisher p2 ON s2.publisher_id = p2.id
      WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT attribute.attribute_name
FROM attribute
JOIN hero_attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id
JOIN superhero ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';
SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence'
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'in-patient'
        ELSE 'outpatient'
    END AS more_common,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '30609';

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 500;

SELECT P.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5'

SELECT AVG(E.`aCL IgG`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '+'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2."Examination Date") = '1997'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Birthday)
    FROM Patient AS T3
    JOIN Examination AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
)
AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12.0
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T2.SEX = 'M'

SELECT L.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', P."First Date") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."Birthday") AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2."Examination Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."First Date") AS INTEGER) >= 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 18 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2."T-BIL" >= '2.0'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31 ') GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID

LIMIT 1

SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY "Examination Date" LIMIT 1);
SELECT "aCL IgM" FROM Examination WHERE "Examination Date" = '1993/11/12' AND ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Description = '1994-02-19');
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis

FROM Patient

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Patient.ID IN (SELECT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND Laboratory."T-BIL" < 2.0)
