SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997' AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);
SELECT SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%') * 100.0 / SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%') FROM Examination WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT JULIANDAY((SELECT MIN(`Examination Date`) FROM Examination WHERE ID = 821298)) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) FROM Patient WHERE ID = 821298

SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994' AND T2.GOT < 60

SELECT T2.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS AGE
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP < 300
SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "ALP within normal range" FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;
SELECT L.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS ALB_Normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Laboratory.UA > 6.5 THEN Patient.ID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));
SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE UN = 29);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F')
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

FROM Patient

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991' AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.HGB < 10

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

  FROM yearmonth y

JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id

JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS annual
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(annual) AS minannual
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(t.annual) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avgannual
    FROM czk2013 t
    JOIN minima m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.annual = m.minannual
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgannual FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avgannual FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avgannual FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avgannual FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avgannual FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avgannual FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
          / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM seg ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1) AS Biggest,
    (SELECT Segment FROM seg ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS Lowest;

    SELECT L.ID, L.UA
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
) AS Latest
INNER JOIN Patient P ON Latest.ID = P.ID
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND Latest.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND Latest.UA < 6.5);

JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

    FROM schools s

    UNION ALL
    SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName2), s.District
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmFName2) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TRIM(s.AdmFName3), s.District
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.AdmFName3) <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
),
top_two AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM name_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
)

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND substr(CAST(ym.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN min_cons AS m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth AS ym
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct
  FROM seg
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS type, Segment, pct
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS type, Segment, pct
FROM (SELECT Segment, pct FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1);

JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.full_name = 'Helen Parr'
SELECT r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.weight_kg = 108 AND s.height_cm = 188

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN race ON race.id = superhero.race_id
WHERE hero_attribute.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(hero_attribute.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';
SELECT superhero.full_name FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue' LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value)
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 1 AND superhero.gender_id = 2;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 WHERE T1.alignment_id = 2

SELECT SUM(T2.id = 7) - SUM(T2.id = 1)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero AS s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE c.colour = 'Green' AND a.alignment = 'Bad'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS s JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
SELECT superhero.superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero.height_cm = (SELECT MAX(superhero.height_cm) FROM superhero)
SELECT superhero.superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT T1.hero_id FROM hero_attribute AS T1 ORDER BY T1.attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT superhero.full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Alien'

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg < 100
  AND colour.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(s2.height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero s2);
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Patient.ID) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Patient.ID) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS ratio FROM Patient WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis, Laboratory.Date
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = '30609'

SELECT p."SEX", p."Birthday", e."Examination Date", e."Symptoms"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1937'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND (Laboratory.TP < '6.0' OR Laboratory.TP > '8.5') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT AVG(T1."aCL IgG")
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) = '1997' AND Patient.Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND strftime('%Y', Examination."Examination Date") = '1997'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.ID IN (SELECT Laboratory.ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200)

SELECT T3.Symptoms, T3.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = (SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T2 JOIN Examination AS T4 ON T2.ID = T4.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12.0
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT T1.Date, (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS age FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(T2.`Examination Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(T1.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', `Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', `Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0

SELECT Examination.Diagnosis FROM Examination WHERE Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY Examination.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(Examination.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID AND e."Examination Date" = l.Date
JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY l.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Examination.ANA FROM Examination WHERE Examination.ID = 3605340 AND Examination.`Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'
SELECT Patient.SEX FROM Patient WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY Patient."First Date" ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.`Date` LIKE '1995%'

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT E.ID
    FROM Examination E
    WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

);
SELECT T2.Symptoms FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959-03-01' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993-09-27'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'

  AND E."Examination Date" < '1998-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND Laboratory.GPT > 30
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 4;
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'

      FROM `Examination`
  );
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory."UA" <= 6.5 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0 AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) = '1981'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND T2."T-BIL" < 2.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."ANA Pattern" != 'P' AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT AVG(T1.ALB) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.PLT > 400 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Examination.Symptoms
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Examination.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT Patient.Description, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE Patient.ID = 48473
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) = '1997' AND NOT (T1.TP > 6 AND T1.TP < 8.5)
SELECT CAST(SUM(Examination.DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%ITP%') AS REAL) / SUM(Examination.DIAGNOSIS LIKE '%SLE%') * 100 FROM Examination WHERE Examination.Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%'
SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(Patient.SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1980' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Examination."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5

SELECT julianday(MIN(Examination."Examination Date")) - julianday(Patient."First Date") AS days_to_evaluation
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT Laboratory.Date FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.ID = '48473' AND Laboratory.GOT >= 60

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT < 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
SELECT AVG(Laboratory.LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.LDH < 500;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP < 300
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS normal_ALP FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)

SELECT Patient.ID, CASE WHEN Laboratory.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1982' ORDER BY Patient.ID;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'F'

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID)
  AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID

);

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0

SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO" FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory) ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GLU >= 180 AND Laboratory."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'
  AND T2.GLU < 180

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.WBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY Patient.SEX ASC, Patient.Birthday DESC
SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T.HCT) FROM Laboratory AS T WHERE T.Date LIKE '1991%' AND T.HCT < 29
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.PLT <= 100 OR Laboratory.PLT >= 400

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID

WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;
